newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian INA to buy 2.5 mln T crude from Sinochem.
newsitem.headline: Croatian INA to buy 2.5 mln T crude from Sinochem.

text.p: Croatia's state-owned oil concern INA signed a contract on Wednesday to buy 2.5 million tonnes of crude from Chinese giant Sinochem by the year 2000, state news agency Hina reported but gave no value of the deal.
It also envisages joint exploration and production of oil in the third countries, Russia in particular, INA's chief executive Davor Stern told Hina.
For Sinochem, which was Croatia's key supplier with crude throughout the 1991-95 war in former Yugoslavia, the agreement was signed by its president Zheng Dunxun.
Minister of economy Nenad Porges said deals between the companies, put at $630 million last year, represented a lion's share of the total trade between the two countries.
He expressed his hope the contract would help the other Croatian companies find their way to China's vast market. -- Metka Jelenc, Zagreb Newsroom, 385 1 4557075
